title: 第2175章 生命之树诞生意识第2174章 三棵歪脖子树
content_zh:
半个月后，三人掘地三尺，最终找到了三个歪脖子树的遗址。
站在一处水潭旁，维林看着清澈的水面，很想将当年那个贵族抓来好好询问一番，你屠村没什么，烧毁周围山林也没什么，但是你在三棵歪脖子树遗址上挖一个深坑是几个意思。
“主上，接下来要怎么做。”凯尔转头看向沉默的主上，开口询问道。
西莱斯特双手抱胸，脸上满是好奇之色，这周围的空间十分正常，没有丝毫异常波动，那么维林又如何打开他口中的那处神秘空间的通道。
在两人的注视下，维林十分干脆的将血-骑士呼唤出来。
“能否帮我把这座异空间通道打开一下。”
血-骑士看着维林，眼中带着审视：“你的实力不太够。”
“我不够，这里不是还有凯尔和西莱斯特他们吗？”维林伸手指向两人，开口解释道。
“加上他们只能也不够。”
“那不还有你吗？”
听到这话，血-骑士直接说道：“再去找一位传奇来。”
听到这话，维林沉默片刻后，抬头向血-骑士询问道：“真的要再找一位吗？”
“这处异空间极易破碎，我出手的话，里面就什么都不会剩下，要是你想要的结局是这样，我没有意见。”
维林见状，瞬间想起了命运指引曾经提及的信息，传奇阶位，谨慎探索；传奇之上，请勿踏入，避免异空间破碎。
也就是说，这片空间无法承载太强大的个体，否则会崩塌。
“你将实力控制在传奇这一层次也不行吗？”
“里面有一枚神格，上面附着一缕无意识残缺意识，祂一旦感受到我的气息，会选择自爆。”
“那……”
“这是我从未来看见的，至于你想问那一缕意识是谁的话，等你见到他的时候就知道了。”
“好吧。”维林叹了口气，开口说道。

血-骑士见状，化作一道光芒回到维林体内。
“主上，要不我回第六传送阵岛屿一趟，去将摩拉维亚公爵请来。”凯尔开口提议道。
“如今也只能这这样了。”
“我这里有有个方案，不知道你们能否接受。”西莱斯特看着准备离去的凯尔，开口询问道。
“你说。”
“我返回神圣第三晨曦王国找一尊大陆传奇来，这样能节约一些时间。”
权衡利弊后，维林最终还是否决了西莱斯特这个方案。
这样虽然能节省不少时间，但找来的大陆传奇终究不是自己人。
要是里面都是寻常之物，那这样做最符合他的利益，但里面藏着一枚微弱级神格，那就另当别论了。
“凯尔，麻烦你跑一趟了。”
“嗯。”
话音落下，凯尔撕开空间，径直走了进去。
等空间重新愈合后，水潭旁就剩下维林与西莱斯特两人。
两人相互对视一眼后，西莱斯特率先开口询问道：“接下来干什么。”
“要不去我的半位面躺半个月怎么样？”维林见状，开口提议道。
西莱斯特摸了摸下巴，认真思索一番后，开口说道：“也行。”
content_en:
Half a month later, the three of them dug deep into the ground and finally found the remains of three crooked neck trees.
Standing by a pool, Weilin looked at the clear water. He wanted to capture the nobleman and interrogate him. It was okay to massacre the village, and it was okay to burn down the surrounding mountains and forests. But what did you mean by digging a deep pit at the site of three crooked neck trees?
"Master, what should we do next?" Kyle turned to look at the silent master and asked.
Celeste crossed her arms, her face full of curiosity. The surrounding space was very normal, with no abnormal fluctuations at all. So how could Verin open the passage to the mysterious space he mentioned.
Under the gaze of the two men, Verin called out the Blood Knight very simply.
"Can you help me open this different space passage?"
The Blood Knight looked at Verin with scrutiny in his eyes: "You are not strong enough."
"I'm not enough. Aren't there Kyle and Celeste here?" Verin pointed to the two of them and explained.
"Plus they can only do it and it's not enough."
"Then there's still you?"
Upon hearing this, the Blood Knight said directly: "Find another legend."
After hearing this, Verin was silent for a moment, then raised his head and asked the Blood Knight: "Are you really looking for another one?"
"This alien space is extremely easy to break. If I take action, nothing will be left inside. If this is the ending you want, I have no objection."
When Weilin saw this, he instantly remembered the information that Destiny Guidance once mentioned, the legendary level, explore with caution; above the legendary level, please do not step into it to avoid the fragmentation of the different space.
In other words, this space cannot carry an individual that is too powerful, otherwise it will collapse.
"Can't you control your strength to the level of a legend?"
"There is a godhead inside, with a ray of unconscious and incomplete consciousness attached to it. Once it feels my breath, it will choose to self-destruct."
"Then..."
"This is what I saw from the future. As for who you want to ask who is that ray of consciousness, you will know when you see him."
"Okay." Verin sighed and said.
Upon seeing this, the Blood Knight turned into a ray of light and returned to Verin's body.
"My lord, how about I go back to the Sixth Teleportation Array Island and invite the Duke of Moravia?" Kyle suggested.
"This is all we can do now."
"I have a plan here. I wonder if you can accept it." Celeste looked at Kyle who was about to leave and asked.
"You said."
"I will return to the Holy Third Dawn Kingdom to find a mainland legend. This will save some time."
After weighing the pros and cons, Verin finally rejected Celeste's plan.
Although this can save a lot of time, the mainland legend found is not one of our own after all.
If it were all ordinary things, then it would be in his best interest to do so, but if there was a weak-level godhead hidden inside, that would be a different matter.
"Kyle, please run away."
"Yeah."
After the words fell, Kyle tore open the space and walked straight in.
After the space healed again, Verin and Celeste were left alone by the pool.
After the two looked at each other, Celeste was the first to ask: "What to do next."
"How about you go to my demiplane and lie down for half a month?" Seeing this, Verin suggested.
Celeste touched her chin, and after thinking about it seriously, she said, "That's okay."
